title: Minimum Number of Removals to Make Mountain Array
description: Find the minimum number of elements to remove to make the array a mountain (increasing then decreasing).
pseudocode:
1. lis = calculate LIS from left to right
2. lds = calculate LIS from right to left
3. max_len = 0
4. for i from 1 to n-2:
5.   if lis[i] > 1 and lds[i] > 1:
6.     max_len = max(max_len, lis[i] + lds[i] - 1)
7. return n - max_len

steps.note: Calculate LIS (Longest Increasing Subsequence) ending at each index for array [2, 1, 1, 5, 3, 1]
Calculate LDS (Longest Decreasing Subsequence) starting at each index
Peak is valid (LIS=2, LDS=3). Mountain length: 2+3-1 = 4
